operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: how images, edit stacks, proposals, exports and batches work; every edit kind's params, error codes, ready-to-run recipes, your policy and the recent images.
operations.label: Guide

operations.name: app.schema
operations.description: Every edit kind with its label, the filters, the adjust sliders and their ranges, resample filters, fonts and the layer types.
operations.label: Edit kinds

operations.name: app.status
operations.description: The image engine (state, running, busy) and its setup (the one-off download on a new computer: state, groups installed, progress), images (and how many wait for the engine), pending proposals, open requests, running batches and exports.
operations.label: Status

operations.name: app.context
operations.description: What the person is looking at in the app: the view, the open image (with its stack, proposals and exports), the selected tool and edit, a region they drew and the images selected in the library.
operations.label: On screen

operations.name: app.ui
operations.description: The app reports what is on screen (used by the app itself; app.context reads it).
operations.label: Report screen

selection.description: JSON region {x,y,w,h} in pixels of the result

images.description: JSON list of selected image ids

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: Export defaults (format, quality, metadata, strip_gps, matte, effort, resample), the AI agent policy (agent_edits propose or apply, agent_batches propose or run, house rules) and the export folder.
operations.label: Settings

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change the export defaults; the policy and the export folder are the person's to change.
operations.label: Change settings

export_folder.description: Absolute folder the AI agent may write exports into (the person only)

operations.name: engine.status
operations.description: The image engine: installed, running, busy, the job running now and its log tail.
operations.label: Engine

operations.name: engine.install
operations.description: Start (or retry) the one-off download: core (the image engine, about 32 MB), bg (background removal with the fast model, about 20 MB) or bg_detailed (the detailed model, 179 MB). It runs in the background; app.status shows progress. Background models are the person's decision.
operations.label: Install engine

operations.name: engine.test
operations.description: Start the engine if needed and answer with its versions and features (formats, AVIF, models).
operations.label: Test engine

operations.name: images.list
operations.description: Images with size, format, bytes, edit and export counts, status, preview and thumbnail; pinned first. Totals of images, bytes and edited ones.
operations.label: Images

q.description: Search name, title, alt text and keywords

format.description: Only this format (JPEG, PNG, WEBP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO)

operations.name: images.get
operations.description: One image: its facts (size, format, colour profile, alpha, frames, camera and GPS), the edit stack (each edit with its size in and out), pending proposals, exports, requests and undo state.
operations.label: Image

operations.name: images.info
operations.description: Everything the engine reads from the original file: format, mode, bit depth, ICC profile, frames, DPI, EXIF summary (camera, lens, exposure, date), GPS, orientation, hash and a histogram.
operations.label: Image facts

operations.name: images.render
operations.description: A picture of the image to look at: the current result (default), the result just before an edit (upto), a pending proposal's result, the untouched original, or a region at full resolution. Answers with the file path, its URL and size.
operations.label: Render

upto.description: Render the stack up to (not including) this edit id

proposal.description: Render with this pending proposal applied

layers.description: Draw the layers (default true; false shows the photo edits alone)

draft.description: JSON {kind, params}: one more edit on top, not saved (how the app shows an open tool)

region.description: JSON {x,y,w,h} in pixels of the result: that part at full resolution

max.description: Preview size: longest edge in pixels (256..4000, default 1600)

operations.name: images.import
operations.description: Bring images in from this computer: one path, a JSON list of paths or every image in a folder (JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO). The app keeps a copy of each original. Answers with the new images and any files it could not read.
operations.label: Import images

path.description: Absolute path of an image file

folder.description: Absolute path of a folder: every image in it (not subfolders)

operations.name: images.update
operations.description: Rename an image or set its title, alt text (written into exports as the description), caption, notes, keywords or pin.
operations.label: Edit image details

name.description: Name (the base of export file names)

alt_text.description: Alt text: what the image shows, under 125 characters

operations.name: images.duplicate
operations.description: A copy of the image (the same original) with or without its edits, to try another version.
operations.label: Duplicate image

operations.name: images.delete
operations.description: Delete images with their edits and history (their exports stay in Exports). Confirm with the person first.
operations.label: Delete images
operations.confirm: Delete these images and their edits?

operations.name: analyze.image
operations.description: Numbers to edit with: auto (the levels, gamma and white balance Auto would use), trim (the content box inside a flat border), smart (the most interesting crop for a ratio), colors (the main colours), histogram (clipped shadows and highlights) and alpha (the transparent margin).
operations.label: Analyze

what.description: JSON list of: auto, trim, smart, colors, histogram, alpha (default all but alpha)

upto.description: Analyze the result just before this edit id

tolerance.description: For trim: how different from the border colour counts as content (0..255, default 12)

operations.name: filters.previews
operations.description: Small previews of every filter look on this image (paths and URLs).
operations.label: Filter previews

upto.description: Preview on the result just before this edit id

operations.name: edits.add
operations.description: Add a photo edit (crop, resize, canvas, adjust, filter, remove_bg) to an image's stack; objects over the photo are layers (layers.add) (at the end, or at a position). Answers with the stack, the preview and warnings. Under the propose policy, the AI agent's edits become a proposal the person accepts or rejects.
operations.label: Add edit

params.description: JSON object of the edit's params (app.guide edit_kinds, app.schema), e.g. {"mode":"longest","longest":2048} for resize

at.description: Position in the stack (0 = first; default the end)

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

max.description: Preview size: longest edge in pixels (256..4000, default 1600)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: edits.update
operations.description: Change an edit's params (merged into the current ones; a null removes a key; replace=true replaces them all), turn it on or off, or change its note.
operations.label: Change edit

edit.description: Edit id (from the stack in images.get)

params.description: JSON object of the edit's params (app.guide edit_kinds, app.schema), e.g. {"mode":"longest","longest":2048} for resize

replace.description: Replace all params instead of merging

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

max.description: Preview size: longest edge in pixels (256..4000, default 1600)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: edits.move
operations.description: Move an edit to another position in the stack (0 = first).
operations.label: Move edit

edit.description: Edit id (from the stack in images.get)

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: edits.remove
operations.description: Remove one edit or several of the same image (undoable).
operations.label: Remove edits

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: edits.apply
operations.description: Add several edits at once: a recipe or size preset (by id or name), or a JSON list of {kind, params}; replace=true replaces the stack.
operations.label: Apply recipe

preset.description: A recipe or size preset (id or name)

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

max.description: Preview size: longest edge in pixels (256..4000, default 1600)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: edits.copy
operations.description: Copy an image's edits onto other images; positions and sizes scale to each image. Edits that do not fit are skipped and reported.
operations.label: Copy edits

to.description: JSON list of target image ids

kinds.description: JSON list of edit kinds to copy (default all)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: edits.reset
operations.description: Remove every edit of an image in one undoable step.
operations.label: Back to original
operations.confirm: Remove every edit of this image?

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

operations.name: layers.list
operations.description: An image's layers, bottom first: id, type, name, visible, locked, anchor (photo or frame), its params in its own space and in_result (centre, size, rotation or end points in result pixels, as images.render shows them).
operations.label: Layers

operations.name: layers.add
operations.description: Put a layer on top: text, rect, ellipse, arrow, line, highlight, step, pen, redact or logo (app.guide layer_types gives each one's props). Numbers are result pixels unless space=layer. Pinned to the photo by default (it follows crops and turns); anchor=frame pins it to the frame. Under the propose policy, the AI agent's layers are a proposal.
operations.label: Add layer

props.description: JSON of the layer: {"cx":640,"cy":90,"size":56,"text":"New","color":"#ffffff","bg":"#111111"} for text; {"cx","cy","w","h","rotation"} for boxes; {"x1","y1","x2","y2"} for arrows and lines

anchor.description: Pinned to the photo (default) or the frame

name.description: A name shown in the Layers panel

space.description: Numbers in result pixels (default) or the layer's own space

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

max.description: Preview size: longest edge in pixels (256..4000, default 1600)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: layers.update
operations.description: Move, resize, rotate or restyle a layer (props merge into the current ones; a null removes a key), rename it, show or hide it, lock it, change its opacity or what it is pinned to.
operations.label: Change layer

props.description: JSON of what changes, e.g. {"cx":700,"cy":120} or {"rotation":-8} or {"text":"Done"}

locked.description: Locked (the person cannot drag it by accident)

space.description: Numbers in result pixels (default) or the layer's own space

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

max.description: Preview size: longest edge in pixels (256..4000, default 1600)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: layers.arrange
operations.description: Bring a layer to the front, send it to the back, or one step forward or backward among the layers.
operations.label: Arrange layer

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: layers.remove
operations.description: Remove one layer or several (undoable).
operations.label: Remove layers

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

title.description: AI agent: a short title for your proposal (when your edits are proposed)

reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

note.description: A note shown on the edit

operations.name: history.list
operations.description: History, newest first (one image, or every image): batches of changes with kind (edit, undo or redo), who, when, the note and each change (before and after); reverted_by shows a batch already undone.
operations.label: History

operations.name: history.undo
operations.description: Undo the image's last change (a batch of edits).
operations.label: Undo

operations.name: history.redo
operations.description: Redo the change undone last.
operations.label: Redo

operations.name: history.revert
operations.description: Undo one batch of changes (a revert is itself a batch, so it can be undone). dry_run=true renders the result first.
operations.label: Revert change

dry_run.description: Render the result without saving it (answers with a preview path)

operations.name: proposals.list
operations.description: The AI agent's proposals (edits for one image, or a batch): title, reason, the edits, before and after previews.
operations.label: Proposals

operations.name: proposals.accept
operations.description: Accept a proposal: its edits become the image's (or the batch is ready to run). The person only.
operations.label: Accept proposal

operations.name: proposals.reject
operations.description: Reject a proposal: its edits are removed. The person only.
operations.label: Reject proposal

operations.name: export.estimate
operations.description: Encode the current result with one or more outputs without keeping them: real file sizes, dimensions, saving against the original, the quality chosen for a target size and whether it was met.
operations.label: Estimate export

outputs.description: JSON list of outputs [{"format":"webp","quality":"balanced"},{"format":"jpeg","mode":"size","target_kb":500,"longest":2048}]. Per output: format, quality (best, balanced, small or 1..100), mode (quality, size, lossless), target_kb, longest, scale, square, enlarge, suffix, name, ico_sizes, palette (auto, on, off), progressive, subsampling (auto, 420, 444), effort (fast, normal, max)

preset.description: An export preset (id or name, presets.list --kind export) instead of outputs

format.description: One output: its format (instead of outputs)

quality.description: One output: best, balanced, small or 1..100

mode.description: One output: quality (default), size (fit target_kb) or lossless

target_kb.description: One output, mode size: the largest file in KB

longest.description: One output: longest edge in pixels (it never enlarges)

scale.description: One output: scale factor (0.5 = half size)

metadata.description: keep (all), basic (camera, date, author, copyright, description) or none

matte.description: Background for transparency in formats without it (#ffffff)

operations.name: export.compare
operations.description: The same region before and after encoding with one output's settings, at 100 % (two PNG paths), with the encoded size, to judge artefacts.
operations.label: Compare quality

cx.description: Centre x of the region (pixels of the result; default the most detailed part)

name.description: Base file name (default the image name)

folder.description: Also copy into this absolute folder

operations.description: Kept exports, newest first: file name, path, format, size, dimensions, saving, image, batch and who made it.
operations.label: Exports

operations.name: exports.delete
operations.description: Delete kept exports (copies already written to a folder stay).
operations.label: Delete exports

operations.name: presets.list
operations.description: Presets: export (outputs and metadata), size (social and web sizes, applied as a cover resize) and recipe (a list of edits).
operations.label: Presets

operations.name: presets.save
operations.description: Save a new preset or change one of yours (built-in ones are kept). export: data {"outputs":[..],"metadata":"basic"}; size: {"width":1080,"height":1350}; recipe: {"edits":[{kind, params}]} (no crop boxes: crops by ratio; layers only when pinned to the frame).
operations.label: Save preset

preset.description: Preset id or name to change

from_image.description: recipe: take the edits of this image

operations.name: presets.delete
operations.description: Delete a preset you saved (built-in ones cannot be deleted).
operations.label: Delete preset

operations.name: batches.list
operations.description: Batches with status (draft, proposed, queued, running, done, failed, cancelled), progress, files written and bytes saved.
operations.label: Batches

operations.name: batches.get
operations.description: One batch: the images, the recipe, the outputs, the rename pattern, the folder, per-image results (files, sizes, errors) and the zip of everything when it is done.
operations.label: Batch

operations.name: batches.create
operations.description: Plan a batch: one recipe and one set of outputs for many images, file names from a rename pattern ({name} {n} {n:3} {date} {taken} {width} {height} {format} {batch}). It does not run yet: batches.preview, then batches.run. Created by the AI agent under the propose policy, it waits for the person.
operations.label: New batch

recipe_preset.description: A recipe or size preset to apply (id or name)

edits.description: JSON list of {kind, params} to apply (after the preset); layers must be pinned to the frame (anchor frame)

use_edits.description: Start from each image's own edits (default true) or from the original

folder.description: Also copy the files into this absolute folder

collision.description: When a file exists in the folder

outputs.description: JSON list of outputs [{"format":"webp","quality":"balanced"},{"format":"jpeg","mode":"size","target_kb":500,"longest":2048}]. reason.description: AI agent: why, in one or two lines the person reads with your proposal

operations.description: Before running: every planned file name with its size in pixels, duplicate names, files already in the folder, a few real encodes and the estimated total.
operations.label: Preview batch

samples.description: How many images to encode as samples (0..5, default 3)

operations.name: batches.run
operations.description: Queue a batch; the worker runs it in the background (batches.get shows progress). The AI agent may run only when the policy allows it.

operations.name: batches.cancel
